name: Adorjás (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Adorjás (a red shield with a yellow lion, a fleur-de-lis and stars on a blue chief) within a wreath of oak and olive branches, above a yellow scroll inscribed ADORJÁS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
